FORM.notes: source note: ma-qianux活著、過活;k<in>qianux；生活。 | source note: ma-qianux活著、過活;k<in>qianux；生活。

S.FORM: e kalanaymu tikay ku nanu' a kinqianuxniam lawwi gi.
S.PHON: e kalanajmu tikaj ku nanuʔ a kinqianuxniam lawwi ɣi
S.FORM: e kalanaymu tikay ku nanu' a kinqianuxniam lawwi gi.
S.PHON: e kalanajmu tikaj ku nanuʔ a kinqianuxniam lawwi ɣi
S.TRANSL: 讓我再說一些(過去的)生活.
Let me talk a little about the life (in the past) again.

S.FORM: sawni ga ini'mu u naqarani kumal gi kia tikay uwi na' tiku salun mha u.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]awni ɣa iniʔmu u naqarani kumal ɣi kia tikaj uwi naʔ tiku [s|ɕ]alun mħa u
S.FORM: sawni ga ini'mu u naqarani kumal gi kia tikay uwi na' tiku salun mha u.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]awni ɣa iniʔmu u naqarani kumal ɣi kia tikaj uwi naʔ tiku [s|ɕ]alun mħa u
S.TRANSL: 今天,我還沒講完,還有一些應該要講.
Today, I have not finished talking, and there is still a little that should be talked about.

FORM.notes: source note: tuvux 灑種(祈使形式)。 | source note: asi語意上修飾其後的動詞，單獨使用時根據語境有「只能」、「只有」等語意。和特定的功能詞使用時則修飾其後的命題，有「必要」（asi ki）、「好像」（asi ga）等語意。目前將此類用法合併為一個單位標記。 | source note: 汶水泰雅口語語料中會有語助詞和其他功能詞(主題標記、連接詞、主格)等連讀的現象（lga, lru, lgi, lku, etc.）。目前將此類例子拆解為兩個單位標記。

S.FORM: e tumuvux hani ga asiki pakaavagan la ga.
S.PHON: e tumu*ux ħani ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki pakaa*aɣan la ɣa
S.FORM: e tumuvux hani ga asiki pakaavagan la ga.
S.PHON: e tumu*ux ħani ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki pakaa*aɣan la ɣa
S.TRANSL: 播種這件事情應該是在將要夏天的時候.
Sowing this thing should be at the time when summer is coming.

S.FORM: mana'aring kia tumuvux la.
S.PHON: manaʔariŋ kia tumu*ux la
S.FORM: mana'aring kia tumuvux la.
S.PHON: manaʔariŋ kia tumu*ux la
S.TRANSL: 那時開始播種.
Then sowing begins.

FORM.notes: source note: pan-sapung-an或pa-sapung-an規範；pa-sapung決定的人；sapung決定。 | source note: 汶水泰雅不同村之間有b/v, c/s等發音上的差異。清安村發音人較年輕一輩的詞彙已無b和c的音，但較年長的發音人的部分詞彙仍保留b和c的音。此篇語料係依照發音人的發音而給予標記。 | source note: maga完整的說法為mha’ ga。 | source note: yani vay為suvalay簡稱。 | source note: anaring-an應為na’aring-an。

S.FORM: tumuvux ru kia ku pansapungan nku navakis sunga' mha u maquwas ku qavahaniq mha u tutut tutut la maga yani vay la ku a anaringan i tumuvux.
S.PHON: tumu*ux ru kia ku pan[s|ɕ]apuŋan nku na*aki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ mħa u maquwa[s|ɕ] ku qa*aħaniq mħa u tutut tutut la maɣa jani *aj la ku a anariŋan i tumu*ux
S.FORM: tumuvux ru kia ku pansapungan nku navakis sunga' mha u maquwas ku qavahaniq mha u tutut tutut la maga yani vay la ku a anaringan i tumuvux.
S.PHON: tumu*ux ru kia ku pan[s|ɕ]apuŋan nku na*aki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ mħa u maquwa[s|ɕ] ku qa*aħaniq mħa u tutut tutut la maɣa jani *aj la ku a anariŋan i tumu*ux
S.TRANSL: 播種,然後以前老人有規定,說當鳥叫的時候,這個時候正是開始播種的時候.
Sowing and there are regulations of old men in the past, saying when the birds chirp, this is exactly the time to begin sowing.

FORM.notes: source note: ma-napusal做兩次；napusal-un 做第二次；usaing 二；tutut是某一種鳥，類似布穀鳥。 | source note: 此處之asi ki在別處標法為asi.ki (請參照IU10註解)。目前暫時將拆散的ki標記為linker。

S.FORM: ru panapusan i mha tutut la ku tutut vay ga la ga asi vay ki tumuvux ana i.
S.PHON: ru panapu[s|ɕ]an i mħa tutut la ku tutut *aj ɣa la ɣa a[s|ɕ]i *aj ki tumu*ux ana i
S.FORM: ru panapusan i mha tutut la ku tutut vay ga la ga asi vay ki tumuvux ana i.
S.PHON: ru panapu[s|ɕ]an i mħa tutut la ku tutut *aj ɣa la ɣa a[s|ɕ]i *aj ki tumu*ux ana i
S.TRANSL: 然後鳥叫第二次的時候,真的必須無論如何都要播種了.
And when the birds chirp the again, (they) should sow no matter what.

FORM.notes: source note: vuyqa竹子；va-vuyqa竹園；無utux-un；m<in>ang開墾。

S.FORM: tiku vavuyqa sunga' ga mutux nha' panangun uwi ru.
S.PHON: tiku *a*ujqa [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣa mutux nħaʔ panaŋun uwi ru
S.FORM: tiku vavuyqa sunga' ga mutux nha' panangun uwi ru.
S.PHON: tiku *a*ujqa [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣa mutux nħaʔ panaŋun uwi ru
S.TRANSL: 他們過去也開墾竹子林.
They also plowed bamboo forests in the past.

FORM.notes: source note: mamati'原意為指物體的硬度，此處引申為困難之意。 | source note: "挖"之AF型為k<um>ayhu。

S.FORM: e mamati' tuvuxan ga asiki maymaw i ma'uva' a rawiq i musa' i e tumuvux gi mamati' gi vali i kinhiwan na nanu' na asi panangi kia ru.
S.PHON: e mamatiʔ tu*uxan ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki majmaw i maʔu*aʔ a rawiq i mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i e tumu*ux ɣi mamatiʔ ɣi *ali i kinħiwan na nanuʔ na a[s|ɕ]i panaŋi kia ru
S.FORM: e mamati' tuvuxan ga asiki maymaw i ma'uva' a rawiq i musa' i e tumuvux gi mamati' gi vali i kinhiwan na nanu' na asi panangi kia ru.
S.PHON: e mamatiʔ tu*uxan ɣa a[s|ɕ]iki majmaw i maʔu*aʔ a rawiq i mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i e tumu*ux ɣi mamatiʔ ɣi *ali i kinħiwan na nanuʔ na a[s|ɕ]i panaŋi kia ru
S.TRANSL: 播種困難到要(做)到翻白眼的程度.去播種很難因為(他們)沒有什麼可以用來挖,那時就直接(徒手)開墾.
Sowing was so hard that they must (do it) to the degree of rolling their eyes. Going sowing was hard because (they) did not dig with anything then but they still plowed.

FORM.notes: source note: l<um>awm 燒。

S.FORM: a silawm la ru tumuvux la.
S.PHON: a [s|ɕ]ilawm la ru tumu*ux la
S.FORM: a silawm la ru tumuvux la.
S.PHON: a [s|ɕ]ilawm la ru tumu*ux la
S.TRANSL: 燒完之後就播種.
Burning and then sowing.

FORM.notes: source note: hal-anay口誤，應為hal-ani。

S.FORM: tumuvux ku la ga mutux nha' sikaal sku navakis mha u halanay tikay i i pana'aring i sumi'atu' gi.
S.PHON: tumu*ux ku la ɣa mutux nħaʔ [s|ɕ]ikaal [s|ɕ]ku na*aki[s|ɕ] mħa u ħalanaj tikaj i i panaʔariŋ i [s|ɕ]umiʔatuʔ ɣi
S.FORM: tumuvux ku la ga mutux nha' sikaal sku navakis mha u halanay tikay i i pana'aring i sumi'atu' gi.
S.PHON: tumu*ux ku la ɣa mutux nħaʔ [s|ɕ]ikaal [s|ɕ]ku na*aki[s|ɕ] mħa u ħalanaj tikaj i i panaʔariŋ i [s|ɕ]umiʔatuʔ ɣi
S.TRANSL: 要播種的時候,他們會向老人家說:＂去開始祈福一下.＂
Before sowing, they would say to the elders, saying "Go and begin to pray a little."

FORM.notes: source note: 此處ma應為maha的減縮。

S.FORM: ini' mamu satuwi ga mutux mutux i niqun na kuwi ku a luvuqnia' ru mutux aqih ku tinuvuxan ma.
S.PHON: iniʔ mamu [s|ɕ]atuwi ɣa mutux mutux i niqun na kuwi ku a lu*uqniaʔ ru mutux aqiħ ku tinu*uxan ma
S.FORM: ini' mamu satuwi ga mutux mutux i niqun na kuwi ku a luvuqnia' ru mutux aqih ku tinuvuxan ma.
S.PHON: iniʔ mamu [s|ɕ]atuwi ɣa mutux mutux i niqun na kuwi ku a lu*uqniaʔ ru mutux aqiħ ku tinu*uxan ma
S.TRANSL: 如果你不祈福,蟲會吃他的嫩芽,然後播種會不好.
If you don't pray, worms will eat his sprouts and sowing will be bad.

FORM.notes: source note: pa-siqasu為patiqsu’口誤，指第一次收割到煮來吃的過程。 | source note: patuaw-an 耕作/工作的地方

S.FORM: sikaal nha' sku nangi' na qamisuan mha u hali i pasiqasu ru nanu' na naki 'i' valayq ku pintuwawan nha' la ma.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]ikaal nħaʔ [s|ɕ]ku naŋiʔ na qami[s|ɕ]uan mħa u ħali i pa[s|ɕ]iqa[s|ɕ]u ru nanuʔ na naki ʔiʔ *alajq ku pintuwawan nħaʔ la ma
S.FORM: sikaal nha' sku nangi' na qamisuan mha u hali i pasiqasu ru nanu' na naki 'i' valayq ku pintuwawan nha' la ma.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]ikaal nħaʔ [s|ɕ]ku naŋiʔ na qami[s|ɕ]uan mħa u ħali i pa[s|ɕ]iqa[s|ɕ]u ru nanuʔ na naki ʔiʔ *alajq ku pintuwawan nħaʔ la ma
S.TRANSL: 他們對一位兄長說:＂去做第一次收成儀式.＂這樣他們的作物才會好.
They say to an elder, "Go and perform the ceremony of first harvest," and then their crop would be good.

FORM.notes: source note: vavaw這裡指「下一次/之後」。

S.FORM: ru' vavawnia' la ga gi kumloh deshihou la ga pasay aring i kumloh la ga.
S.PHON: ruʔ *a*awniaʔ la ɣa ɣi kumloħ *e[s|ɕ]ħiħou la ɣa pa[s|ɕ]aj ariŋ i kumloħ la ɣa
S.FORM: ru' vavawnia' la ga gi kumloh deshihou la ga pasay aring i kumloh la ga.
S.PHON: ruʔ *a*awniaʔ la ɣa ɣi kumloħ *e[s|ɕ]ħiħou la ɣa pa[s|ɕ]aj ariŋ i kumloħ la ɣa
S.TRANSL: 然後下次開始收成的時候.
And next time when beginning to harvest.

FORM.notes: source note: m<in>aglu結伴；*glu’un；ma-paglu 結伴；pa-glu要跟隨；glu=mu我的親戚/我的另一半。 | source note: m<in>aglu結伴；*glu’un；ma-paglu 結伴；pa-glu要跟隨；glu=mu我的親戚/我的另一半。 | source note: t<in>vux-an指「收成」。 | source note: t<in>vux-an指「收成」。 | source note: vuay此指「稻穗」。

S.FORM: nanu' a mutux maglu ku yakiyaki' mha halayta' i kumloh gi valayq vay ku a tinvuxan ru valayq ku vuaynia'.
S.PHON: nanuʔ a mutux maɣlu ku jakijakiʔ mħa ħalajtaʔ i kumloħ ɣi *alajq *aj ku a tin*uxan ru *alajq ku *uajniaʔ
S.FORM: nanu' a mutux maglu ku yakiyaki' mha halayta' i kumloh gi valayq vay ku a tinvuxan ru valayq ku vuaynia'.
S.PHON: nanuʔ a mutux maɣlu ku jakijakiʔ mħa ħalajtaʔ i kumloħ ɣi *alajq *aj ku a tin*uxan ru *alajq ku *uajniaʔ
S.TRANSL: 年長婦女會結伴說:＂我們一起去收割,因為作物很好,然後稻穗很好.＂
Elderly women would come in groups and say, "Let's go and harvest, because the crop is good and its ear is good."

S.FORM: ru' XXXX musa' suvalay kumloh ku yakiyaki' ru.
S.PHON: ruʔ xxxx mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]u*alaj kumloħ ku jakijakiʔ ru
S.FORM: ru' XXXX musa' suvalay kumloh ku yakiyaki' ru.
S.PHON: ruʔ xxxx mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]u*alaj kumloħ ku jakijakiʔ ru
S.TRANSL: 年長的婦女們就真的去收割.
And elderly women indeed go harvesting.

FORM.notes: source note: q<um>vuwang為用槍/狗的狩獵形式。pa-sapung-i這裡為「做主、參與」的意思。 | source note: q<um>vuwang為用槍/狗的狩獵形式。pa-sapung-i這裡為「做主、參與」的意思。 | source note: ini' ga意思為「不然的話」。

S.FORM: tiku tamalung hiya' ga ini' nha' pasapungi gi musa' qumvuwang su e vahut ini' ga musa' sumvu' su.
S.PHON: tiku tamaluŋ ħijaʔ ɣa iniʔ nħaʔ pa[s|ɕ]apuŋi ɣi mu[s|ɕ]aʔ qum*uwaŋ [s|ɕ]u e *aħut iniʔ ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]um*uʔ [s|ɕ]u
S.FORM: tiku tamalung hiya' ga ini' nha' pasapungi gi musa' qumvuwang su e vahut ini' ga musa' sumvu' su.
S.PHON: tiku tamaluŋ ħijaʔ ɣa iniʔ nħaʔ pa[s|ɕ]apuŋi ɣi mu[s|ɕ]aʔ qum*uwaŋ [s|ɕ]u e *aħut iniʔ ɣa mu[s|ɕ]aʔ [s|ɕ]um*uʔ [s|ɕ]u
S.TRANSL: 至於男人,他們不參與,因為他們去獵松鼠,不然的話就是射熊.
As for men, they do not let them participate, becaue (the men) go hunting squirrels, or if not, shooting bears.

S.FORM: u ini' nha' pasapungi ku tamalung hiya' gi yaku kakanayrin ku lawkah.
S.PHON: u iniʔ nħaʔ pa[s|ɕ]apuŋi ku tamaluŋ ħijaʔ ɣi jaku kakanajrin ku lawkaħ
S.FORM: u ini' nha' pasapungi ku tamalung hiya' gi yaku kakanayrin ku lawkah.
S.PHON: u iniʔ nħaʔ pa[s|ɕ]apuŋi ku tamaluŋ ħijaʔ ɣi jaku kakanajrin ku lawkaħ
S.TRANSL: 他們不讓男人決定,因為這些女人很強勢.
They do not let men decide it, because these women are strong.

FORM.notes: source note: p<in>ang-an開墾過的地方。 | source note: p<in>ang-an開墾過的地方。

S.FORM: nanu' tiku a tinvuxan nha' yaku tamalung han ku musa' han i minang han ru naqaru' i minang la ga situ' nha' sku kakanayrin mha u a hali la i tumuvux ru.
S.PHON: nanuʔ tiku a tin*uxan nħaʔ jaku tamaluŋ ħan ku mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ħan i minaŋ ħan ru naqaruʔ i minaŋ la ɣa [s|ɕ]ituʔ nħaʔ [s|ɕ]ku kakanajrin mħa u a ħali la i tumu*ux ru
S.FORM: nanu' tiku a tinvuxan nha' yaku tamalung han ku musa' han i minang han ru naqaru' i minang la ga situ' nha' sku kakanayrin mha u a hali la i tumuvux ru.
S.PHON: nanuʔ tiku a tin*uxan nħaʔ jaku tamaluŋ ħan ku mu[s|ɕ]aʔ ħan i minaŋ ħan ru naqaruʔ i minaŋ la ɣa [s|ɕ]ituʔ nħaʔ [s|ɕ]ku kakanajrin mħa u a ħali la i tumu*ux ru
S.TRANSL: 這些男人先去開墾他們播種的地方.完成墾地後,他們叫女人們去播種.
These men go first and plow the place where they sow. After finishing plowing, they tell women to go and sow.

S.FORM: valayq vay ku tinuxanta' ru.
S.PHON: *alajq *aj ku tinuxantaʔ ru
S.FORM: valayq vay ku tinuxanta' ru.
S.PHON: *alajq *aj ku tinuxantaʔ ru
S.TRANSL: 我們的收成非常好.
Our crop is really good.

S.FORM: teri tasiaringta' i kumloh la ga nanu' a paqasawta' kaxavaw ma.
S.PHON: teri ta[s|ɕ]iariŋtaʔ i kumloħ la ɣa nanuʔ a paqa[s|ɕ]awtaʔ kaxa*aw ma
S.FORM: teri tasiaringta' i kumloh la ga nanu' a paqasawta' kaxavaw ma.
S.PHON: teri ta[s|ɕ]iariŋtaʔ i kumloħ la ɣa nanuʔ a paqa[s|ɕ]awtaʔ kaxa*aw ma
S.TRANSL: 我們開始收成,然後我們都很開心.
We start harvesting and then we are all happy.

FORM.notes: source note: patiqsu；miam為niam「我們」的口誤。

S.FORM: ru musa' i kumloh vay ku nanavakis sunga' ga mutux nha' i halan i pasiaqsu' mha halaymian i a kumloh han ru.
S.PHON: ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i kumloħ *aj ku nana*aki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣa mutux nħaʔ i ħalan i pa[s|ɕ]iaq[s|ɕ]uʔ mħa ħalajmian i a kumloħ ħan ru
S.FORM: ru musa' i kumloh vay ku nanavakis sunga' ga mutux nha' i halan i pasiaqsu' mha halaymian i a kumloh han ru.
S.PHON: ru mu[s|ɕ]aʔ i kumloħ *aj ku nana*aki[s|ɕ] [s|ɕ]uŋaʔ ɣa mutux nħaʔ i ħalan i pa[s|ɕ]iaq[s|ɕ]uʔ mħa ħalajmian i a kumloħ ħan ru
S.TRANSL: (他們)真的去收割,然後以前老人家他們會去做第一次收割儀式,說:＂我們先收割.＂
(They) really go harvesting, and in the past the elders would go and perform the ceremony of first harvest, and say "Let's go harvesting first."

FORM.notes: source note: t<in>a-'aring表示「最先的部分」。 | source note: t<in>a-'aring表示「最先的部分」。

S.FORM: tiku tina'aring nha' i kumloh mutux nha' pugian ru gi.
S.PHON: tiku tinaʔariŋ nħaʔ i kumloħ mutux nħaʔ puɣian ru ɣi
S.FORM: tiku tina'aring nha' i kumloh mutux nha' pugian ru gi.
S.PHON: tiku tinaʔariŋ nħaʔ i kumloħ mutux nħaʔ puɣian ru ɣi
S.TRANSL: 他們會日曬第一批收成.
They will sundry their first collection of harvest.

S.FORM: marngu' la ga nanu' suxuunnha' cku' luhiun gi vali kia' a' kikay sunga.
S.PHON: marŋuʔ la ɣa nanuʔ [s|ɕ]uxuunnħaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ luħiun ɣi *ali kiaʔ aʔ kikaj [s|ɕ]uŋa
S.FORM: marngu' la ga nanu' suxuunnha' cku' luhiun gi vali kia' a' kikay sunga.
S.PHON: marŋuʔ la ɣa nanuʔ [s|ɕ]uxuunnħaʔ [ʦ|ʨ]kuʔ luħiun ɣi *ali kiaʔ aʔ kikaj [s|ɕ]uŋa
S.TRANSL: (收成)乾了之後,他們會用臼來搗小米,因為以前沒有機器.
After (the harvest) is dried, they would thresh millet with a mortar, because there was no machine in the past.

FORM.notes: source note: mata-va-vuax「變成米粒」不管哪一種米；vuax na’ turakis小米顆粒。 | source note: taviq-aw專門指「搗麻糬」。

S.FORM: suxuunnha' ru i matavavuax la ga sa ivuwi la u taviqawta' la.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]uxuunnħaʔ ru i mata*a*uax la ɣa [s|ɕ]a i*uwi la u ta*iqawtaʔ la
S.FORM: suxuunnha' ru i matavavuax la ga sa ivuwi la u taviqawta' la.
S.PHON: [s|ɕ]uxuunnħaʔ ru i mata*a*uax la ɣa [s|ɕ]a i*uwi la u ta*iqawtaʔ la
S.TRANSL: 他們搗米,然後(種子)變成米粒之後,(他們)說:＂我們來搗麻糬.＂
